newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel unions threaten July 23 strike.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel unions threaten July 23 strike.

text.p: French trade unions at Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc threatened on Tuesday to stage a one-day strike on July 23, accusing management of ignoring their grievances over salaries and working hours.

Union officials said they hoped to begin negotiations with management and reach an agreement before that date on their demands for higher salaries, bonuses and a reduction in the working week to 35 hours from 37.5.
The officials said a strike was not a certainty in any case as unions may decide to carry out other forms of protest, such as demonstrations.
A decision on the form of protest would be announced at a news conference this Thursday, they said.

The unions, in a joint statement, said they blamed Eurotunnel management for endlessly repeating mistakes of the past, managing with only short-term interests in mind and remaining aloof from employees.
